subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Stalking Evil: A Ricky Steele Mystery
email_body:
Hi M. Lee,

I came across your work through the Association of Rhode Island Authors and was struck by how many series you have built, from the Morgan's Run romances to the Ricky Steele mysteries. The premise of Stalking Evil, where a routine insurance investigation at an over-fifty community turns into a double homicide, is a fun hook. A retired professor turned full-time novelist is also a story readers enjoy.
